text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold City didn't show up for training.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A shop I visit often messaged me saying, 
'We got new arrivals in'...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We got so wrapped up talking about our 
outfits that I totally lost track of 
time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Gold City bowed her head again saying, 
"I'm sorry," I firmly warned her to be 
more careful next time.
